thread:
ana (PM): Quick proposal for observability roadmap slice: narrow scope to shipable MVP in 2 sprints. Candidate pieces: 1) per-route cost heatmap + gzipped CSV export, 2) trace deep-links surfaced from latency spike detection, 3) error-regression widget with grouped alerts and simple runbook links. We need a prioritization call: what can we cut if timebox hits?
jorge (eng): Tech sketch: route tagging at the edge (route_id) + tokens metric tagging. Minimal materialized view for UIs. Rough estimate: 6 dev-days for tagging+views, 2 days for export, 3 days for trace linking and annotation. Backfill for historical cost is heavy (~4 infra-days). If we must cut, drop historical backfill from GA and add later.
ruth (sre): Observability ops guidance: sampling is required. Recommend default 0.3% sampling, full-capture on error signatures, and a configurable per-deployment override. Alerting should group by fingerprint and include trace link. Also propose a rate-limit per-customer for alerts to avoid paging the oncall.
sam (design): UI thoughts: three compact cards, with the cost heatmap collapsed by default and a "show top routes" quick list. Latency card highlights p95 spikes and exposes "open trace" CTA. Error card shows signal + top example request. I can push a mobile-friendly mock by Tue.
maria (cs): Customer asks summary: Dedicated/Private customers want per-deployment + per-route breakdown and CSV export for finance teams. Hosted customers care more about quick traces and error alerts. Pilot customers asked for explicit admin toggle for exports. Also request timezone-aware exports and a column for estimated_usd.
nana (PM): (typo) meant ana above :)
ana (PM): Launch criteria candidate: templates present in Console, one pilot using CSV export + trace links, ops doc for sampling + alerts, and GA docs. No historical backfill required for GA. Target: end of sprint 5.
jorge (eng): Implementation risks: 1) tagging rollout must be feature-flagged to avoid polluting metrics; 2) exposing trace_id in headers has privacy implications for hosted customers; default to off for hosted, enabled for Dedicated/Private with consent; 3) export endpoint must be rate-limited and gzipped to avoid abuse.
ruth (sre): Proposed alert thresholds to discuss: warn if error_rate > 0.008 (0.8%) over 24h, escalate if > 0.02. For latency spikes, trigger trace capture if p95 increases >30% vs baseline. Add grouping by error signature.
sam (design): Copy recommendations: toggle text 'Capture full traces for errors' and 'Enable route-level cost estimates'. Add a small explainer: 'Cost estimates are approximate; backfilled historical data only when backfill job runs.'
maria (cs): Pilot plan: recruit Customer Z (finance-heavy) and Customer Y (SaaS scale). Requirements to confirm: admin-only export toggle, export columns: start,end,route_id,deployment_id,tokens,estimated_usd,timezone.
infra-bot: CI status: feature/obs-slim-mvp build passed :white_check_mark:.
jorge (eng): Action items: spike on tagging+view (due 2026-04-06), implement export endpoint with gzipped CSV and rate-limits (due 2026-04-09), add header toggle for trace_id (privacy gating) (due 2026-04-09).
ruth (sre): Action items: ops doc for sampling + alert rules (due 2026-04-07), default sampler proposal PR.
sam (design): Action items: mocks + copy by 2026-04-04.
maria (cs): Action items: pilot outreach this week; confirm pilots by Fri.
nana (PM): Prioritization notes: P1 for Dedicated/Private (customer asks), P2 for Hosted. If we need to cut scope in sprint, drop historical backfill and advanced compare modes. Keep CSV export, trace deep-links, and basic error grouping as must-haves.
jorge (eng): Ack.
sam (design): Ack.
ruth (sre): Ack.
maria (cs): Ack.
